name: Storm
description: Storm was a gas giant, and the fifth planet in the Naboo system, located within the Chommell sector on the galaxy's Mid Rim. Its thirty-two moons included its third moon and its tenth moon, which housed a penal colony and Tagge Company outpost respectively.
